title: pdb ball and stick shadows dofssaa
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkOpenGLMoleculeMapper with shadows, depth of field, and SSAA passes.

**dataset → input → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCameraPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCameraPass.html) — camera pass.
- [vtkDepthOfFieldPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDepthOfFieldPass.html) — depth of field pass.
- [vtkLight](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLight.html) — light.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkMoleculeMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMoleculeMapper.html) — molecule mapper.
- [vtkOpenGLMoleculeMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkOpenGLMoleculeMapper.html) — open gl molecule mapper.
- [vtkPDBReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPDBReader.html) — pdb reader.
- [vtkPeriodicTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPeriodicTable.html) — periodic table.
- [vtkPlaneSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlaneSource.html) — generates a rectangular plane.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkRenderPassCollection](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderPassCollection.html) — render pass collection.
- [vtkSSAAPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSSAAPass.html) — ssaa pass.
- [vtkSequencePass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSequencePass.html) — sequence pass.
- [vtkShadowMapPass](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkShadowMapPass.html) — shadow map pass.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
